ChatThread.title: ChatThread
ChatThread.description: A multi-turn AI conversation thread owned by a specific authenticated user.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this thread.

title.description: Display title of the conversation thread.

personaId.description: Identifier of the AI persona active for this thread.

modelName.description: Gemini model identifier used in this thread (e.g., gemini-3.8-flash).

lastMessagePreview.description: Short preview snippet of the latest message in the thread.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the thread was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the thread was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: An individual user or AI model message inside a conversation thread.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this message.

threadId.description: The ID of the parent ChatThread.

hasImage.description: Whether an inline image was attached to this prompt.

imageLabel.description: Descriptive label or summary for an attached image.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Per-user AI model, persona, temperature, voice, and API connection preferences.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated Google user.

selectedModel.description: Selected Gemini model identifier (e.g., gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-3.5-flash-lite, gemini-4-argon).

useCustomApiKey.description: Whether custom API key mode is toggled in settings.

customApiKeyHint.description: Masked or saved custom API key label in user settings.

autoSpeakResponses.description: Whether AI responses should be read aloud automatically via TextToSpeech.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when preferences were last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/threads/{threadId}/messa.description: Stores chronological messages within a user's conversation thread.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: Stores per-user AI configuration, persona, temperature, and API connection settings.
